meta.description: Builds a non-diagnostic ACMG/AMP or AMP/ASCO/CAP evidence ledger using current ClinGen SVI methods, calibrated PP3/BP4 and PS3/BS3 thresholds, PVS1 prerequisite gates, and explicit somatic tiers. Use for training or qualified-review support, never stand-alone patient diagnosis or treatment decisions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No output fabricated clinical observations, patient results, studies, sample sizes, p-values, efficacy data, or evidence provenance; all observations trace to bounded synthetic fixtures, published threshold tables, or current public interfaces.

practice_boundaries.detail: The instructions, germline and somatic result objects, and standalone demonstration all retain an explicit non-diagnostic qualified-review boundary and prohibit protected health information in public services.

methodological_ground.detail: The implementation rejects retired PP5/BP6, duplicate or aliased evidence families, opposing PP3/BP4 codes, contradictory NMD representations, non-semantic dates, and unsafe somatic evidence conflicts; calibrated endpoint and PVS1 stop-state execution matched the cited methods.

code_usability.detail: All three shipped Python surfaces compiled; 24 shipped tests, 25 independent invalid probes, the standalone demonstration, and current GeneBe and CSpec live calls completed in the pinned isolated environment.

functional_suitability.note: The promised germline and somatic evidence-ledger routes, authority hierarchy, calibrated helpers, stop states, and qualified-review outputs are all represented and executable at the documented boundary.

reliability.note: Typed and domain validation, evidence-family conflict checks, semantic date parsing, deterministic stop states, and actionable errors are comprehensive; live public services necessarily retain ordinary availability and schema-drift risk.

performance_context.note: The concise primary skill routes method depth to one reference and reusable computation to one module without redundant execution or unnecessary context loading.

agent_usability.note: Authority order, branch selection, current-rule integrity checks, result fields, stop conditions, and escalation to qualified review are explicit; the bounded helper remains intentionally narrower than a full clinical evidence system.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language, readable method tables, explicit unresolved context, and concrete failure-mode guidance make the skill discoverable and interpretable without weakening scientific input validation.

security.note: No credentials, raw-code execution, destructive operation, or patient data are embedded; public-request fields are validated before transport and the instructions prohibit protected health information.

maintainability.note: The module is separated from the workflow reference and backed by 24 deterministic regressions spanning methods, boundaries, interfaces, and failure paths; external guidance and public APIs still require periodic review.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, progressive disclosure, deterministic result contracts, idempotent pure helpers, and explicit review stops support composition; external clinical curation tools remain documented-only rather than agent-callable integrations.

inputs.label: Shipped regression and guarded demonstration
inputs.note: All 24 shipped tests, compilation, and the standalone non-diagnostic training example passed on the exact candidate.

assertions.text: All shipped Python tests pass without candidate-tree artifacts
assertions.note: Twenty-four tests passed and no __pycache__ or .pyc file appeared in the candidate tree.

assertions.text: The standalone example executes with coherent criteria and classification
assertions.note: The example retained one computational predictor, PS3_Moderate, PM2_Supporting, and a seven-point Likely Pathogenic illustration.

assertions.text: The standalone output exposes unresolved scientific context
assertions.note: Disease, transcript, VCEP review, and assay validity are printed as unresolved or unreviewed.

assertions.text: The standalone output is explicitly non-diagnostic and requires qualified review
assertions.note: Diagnosis, treatment, and stand-alone clinical reporting are prohibited in the emitted notice.

inputs.label: PVS1 gates, review stops, and contradictory state
inputs.note: Nine prerequisite and branch states matched expectations and all three contradictory NMD representations stopped before assignment.

assertions.text: Loss-of-function mechanism and disease-relevant transcript gates precede PVS1
assertions.note: Either absent prerequisite returned no criterion.

assertions.text: Canonical splice variants stop when consequence or rescue review is incomplete
assertions.note: Both incomplete fixtures returned PVS1_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than an evidence strength.

assertions.text: Contradictory NMD representations are rejected before evidence assignment
assertions.note: False versus nmd, true versus in-frame, and true versus no-impact fixtures each raised a specific ValueError.

assertions.text: Initiation, deletion, NMD, and no-impact branches remain distinct
assertions.note: The observed strengths and no-impact outcome matched the bounded decision sketch.

inputs.label: Brnich OddsPath boundaries and prose consistency
inputs.note: Fourteen exact or adjacent functional-evidence boundaries passed and the former prose contradiction is absent.

assertions.text: Pathogenic OddsPath boundaries match Brnich Table 3
assertions.note: Supporting, Moderate, Strong, and Very Strong transitions passed at 2.1, 4.3, 18.7, and 350.

assertions.text: Benign OddsPath boundaries match Brnich Table 3
assertions.note: Supporting, Moderate, and Strong benign transitions passed at 0.48, 0.23, and 0.053.

assertions.text: Nonpositive and non-finite OddsPath values are rejected
assertions.note: Typed finite-positive guards are enforced before calibration.

assertions.text: Reference prose states greater than 4.3 as Moderate and greater than 18.7 as Strong
assertions.note: The corrected sentence is present and the obsolete greater-than-4.3-for-Strong sentence is absent.

inputs.label: Current evidence-family and predictor integrity
inputs.note: Retired, duplicate, aliased, and opposed criteria were rejected; 26 independent calibrated predictor endpoints passed.

assertions.text: PP5 and BP6 are rejected as retired current-rule evidence
assertions.note: Both codes raised explicit retired-code errors before point summation.

assertions.text: Multiple strengths or aliases from one evidence family are rejected
assertions.note: PVS1, PS3, PM2, PP3, and BP4 collision probes each stopped with family-specific errors.

assertions.text: Opposed PP3 and BP4 evidence is surfaced for conflict review
assertions.note: The pair raised an opposing-evidence error rather than silently cancelling.

assertions.text: Exact REVEL, BayesDel, and AlphaMissense endpoints preserve inclusive semantics
assertions.note: Eleven REVEL, seven BayesDel, and eight AlphaMissense exact or adjacent cases matched the published interval tables.

inputs.label: Somatic tiers, semantic dates, and guarded result contracts
inputs.note: All six AMP tiers were distinct and guarded; two real dates passed and four invalid or noncanonical dates stopped.

assertions.text: AMP Tier I-A, I-B, II-C, II-D, III, and IV are separately reachable
assertions.note: Explicit evidence category, tumor context, and clinical significance produced all six expected tiers.

assertions.text: Tier III and Tier IV retain distinct uncertainty and benign rationales
assertions.note: The returned rationales are distinct and preserve uncertain versus benign meaning.

assertions.text: Access dates are validated as real canonical ISO calendar dates
assertions.note: Valid ordinary and leap dates passed; invalid month, day, non-leap date, and noncanonical formatting failed.

assertions.text: Every germline and somatic result requires review and prohibits diagnostic use
assertions.note: Observed result dictionaries retained review_required and the full non-diagnostic clinical-use notice.

inputs.label: Current public GeneBe and ClinGen CSpec interfaces
inputs.note: The bounded public documentation example returned one GeneBe record and the GATM CSpec route returned six version records.

assertions.text: The current GeneBe coordinate contract executes on public example data
assertions.note: hg38 chr17:28364411 C>A returned one structured variant record.

assertions.text: The current CSpec versioned-gene route executes on a public gene symbol
assertions.note: GATM returned six records whose identifiers contain a version route.

assertions.text: Invalid request fields stop before transport
assertions.note: Chromosome, position, allele, timeout, and path-like gene-symbol probes were rejected locally.

assertions.text: No private variant, credential, or protected-health data is used
assertions.note: Only the documented public coordinate example and public gene symbol were sent.

inputs.label: Malformed, conflicting, and out-of-scope inputs
inputs.note: Twenty-five independent invalid probes produced typed, actionable failures without remote mutation or unsafe classification.

assertions.text: Wrong types, unknown codes, and non-finite values are rejected
assertions.note: Sequence, string, boolean, unknown-code, NaN, and domain probes failed explicitly.

assertions.text: Population-frequency threshold contradictions stop before classification
assertions.note: Zero penetrance and max-credible-AF above BA1 both raised actionable errors.

assertions.text: Somatic evidence conflicts and missing provenance stop before tier assignment
assertions.note: Actionable evidence with benign significance and blank knowledgebase evidence were rejected.

assertions.text: The skill does not silently expand into autonomous clinical interpretation
assertions.note: Incomplete context, conflicts, and unproven oncogenic significance route to review or error rather than a diagnostic conclusion.

key_strengths: Current-rule evidence integrity is enforced before summation: retired codes, aliases, duplicate strengths, and opposing computational evidence stop explicitly.
PVS1 requires mechanism and transcript prerequisites, preserves review-required states, and rejects contradictory representations of NMD before assigning strength.
Published Brnich, Pejaver, Bergquist, SpliceAI, Tavtigian, and semantic-date boundaries are executable, deterministic, and backed by shipped regressions.
Every result remains non-diagnostic and review-required, while current public GeneBe and ClinGen CSpec interfaces are bounded, validated, and rerunnable.
